title: Avery's experimental XP to MZ Conversions - default and original

posts.author: Avery
posts.body:
I have been talking about this for years, but I realised it might be more fruitful I made the conversion and people would see themselves what I mean: XP has thinner but taller characters, and due to those differing proportions its animals and monsters are actually the perfect size for MZ - just not the right colors and setup. So if you like what you see and you don't have it yet, just get XP when it is one the next massive sale (which is super cheap for all these things, right?). When I am posting this, XP is on sale for 2,50 ;3
This means, the terms of use are different for this one:
Free for commercial & non-commercial use, as long as I get a free copy of the game.
You may edit these for your own use, but don't post them anywhere without my permission. This includes no asking for edits of them in request boards etc.
Credits to Avery.
You need to own
RMXP
to be allowed to use them legally (so if you own it, I don't care if you use it in Ace or XP or MV or any other RM).
Besides that, those sheets are plug and play to use
Also a note: while there are converters that just cut off the left column, I converted these sheets manually as some movement cycles needed some other operations than that to work in 3 frames instead of 4 and some other detail work.

posts.author: Avery
posts.body:
Thank you all for your kind words, I was a little worried that this was a little of a nieche topic, but I am very happy how many of you seem to enjoy (and more important: use) them!
I am adding some of the support graphics here, I also consider adding some of my own old XP works converted for MZ use later (I mostly think about the boar and about the down pose of the large Behemoth here...).
Here is a little preview since the white sparkles kinda vanish on the white background here:

posts.author: Avery
posts.body:
So, while I could simply just cut off the left column of all XP chars (RTP and my own) and throw them in here, you see that I want to provide a result that a) works as well in style and color as possible and b) has a corrected walk cycle (some 4 frames to 3 frames conversions need some frame rearrangement or some animations need to change from stepping to turning therefore).
Also, while my old XP things are not all super bad, some are just not the quality I wanna provide here.
The "bison" here needed actually some additional manual fixes, some careful color adjustment (the color ramp was kinda off... and I had to rearrange the frames. But in the end, if it gives this big boi a second chance to star in your games, it should be worth it :3
The other three were some of my later XP works and therefore qualitywise just needed the color adjustment and in case of the boar a frame rearrangement. As with the bison, even if I made them years ago, I am still happy if that work is appreciated :3
Even after that time I still like a lot how I turned the chess figure here into a magical guard mecha thing xD

posts.author: Avery
posts.body:
So, I've been thinking whether it might be possible to try and port some of my favorite tileset elements from XP to MZ - of course without scaling, becauce that makes them weirdly blurry and changes the lineweight. And while - as with everything else - there is no one quick way for all, I think I did a quite decent job on these palm trees:
Here is a before and after, you see that we still loose some detail, but in the endit blends better into the MZ style:
The simple question is: is that something you would like to see? I never know how many people own XP, that kinda limits the pool of people who could be interested in those edits xD

posts.author: Avery
posts.body:
After playing around with the palm tree I tried my hand at converting an actual set, this one consists out of tiles from four different tilesets and my own XP edits sprinkled in, all rearranged, a good chunk of it edited to tile with the different grid and color corrected and dithering adjusted.
I don't have the time to actually test it, but it is intended to work with MZ tiles as if, so if one of you would give feedback on how it looks ingame I would be very happy!
Also remember, while everything in this thread is an edit of the default XP stuff, the my credits apply, especially here where my own work is mixed in.

As an owner of XP I very much appreciate your work converting the assets.  I have always liked the XP RTP more than any of the others.
